Kill either [[Harn Coldstone]] or [[Maxine Coldstone]].

==Quest information==
===Objectives===
* Kill either Harn or Maxine Coldstone in [[Perdition Rock]].
* *BONUS* Kill either Harn or Maxine Coldstone in [[Hard Mode]].
* See [[Zehnchu]] <nowiki>[</nowiki>[[Zaishen]] Challenge] for your reward.

===Reward===
*1,000 [[Experience]]
*500 [[Gold]]
*Complete the Base Objective for 20 [[Copper Zaishen Coin|Zaishen Copper Coins]].
*Complete the *BONUS* Objective for an additional 50 Zaishen Copper Coins.

==Walkthrough==
Once a player gets in [[radar]] range of the [[spawn]] point location, either Harn or Maxine will spawn and begin [[patrol]]ling around the island. The boss will go counter-clockwise on its patrol path, so it is best to go clockwise through its patrol path as the boss will move toward you when it spawns and you avoid needing to chase the boss through numerous [[mob]]s. If you go clockwise through its patrol path, there are mobs of [[Flesh Golem (NPC)|Flesh Golems]] and [[Mahgo Hydra]]s that patrol in a circle outside of [[Ember Light Camp]]. Your [[party]] can stay near the [[Resurrection Shrine]] and [[pull]] each mob.

===Skill recommendations===
*If you go clockwise through its patrol path:
**You will only encounter [[spellcaster]] mobs ([[Dark Flame Dryder]]s, [[Drake (NPC)|Drakes]], Flesh Golems, Mahgo Hydras, and [[Phantom (NPC)|Phantoms]]), so consider bringing [[anti-caster]] skills and/or various Ranger [[nature ritual]]s that can benefit your [[party]] but cannot benefit the enemy spellcasters (such as [[Favorable Winds]], [[Infuriating Heat]], [[Toxicity]] since Dark Flame Dryders use [[Chilblains]], and [[Winnowing]]).
**The only [[physical attack]]ers will be the [[Bone Minion]]s created by the Flesh Golems via [[Animate Bone Minions]], so skills that [[block]], cause [[miss]]es, or inflict the [[blind]] condition are less effective here.

==Dialogue==
===Initial dialogue===

===Reward dialogue===
;Zehnchu
:''"Excellent work! The Zaishen admire your dedication."''

==Notes==
*This quest was first offered on April 25, 2009.
*If you go clockwise through the boss' patrol path, you can take this opportunity to obtain a [[Volcanic Rock]].
*It's possible for Harn or Maxine to spawn at the beach on the north part of their path
